purpose: Public, non-identifying inventory of private-to-public capability preservation.

status_vocabulary.PRESERVED: Public component retains the source capability without private data.
status_vocabulary.RESTORED: An accidental public gap was repaired and verified.
status_vocabulary.ABSTRACTED: Method is preserved at a public disease/framework level, not copied verbatim.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Useful public material exists, but the source capability is not yet fully represented.
status_vocabulary.PENDING_CONTENT_REWRITE: Assigned to the content-transformation lane; no empty placeholder is allowed.
status_vocabulary.LEGACY_UNREPRODUCIBLE: Public-derived artifact is retained but exact original execution provenance is unavailable.
status_vocabulary.EXCLUDED_PRIVATE: Deliberately absent because it contains private operational or clinical material.
status_vocabulary.EXCLUDED_THIRD_PARTY: Deliberately not redistributed; represented by licence-aware manifest only.
